messages.subject: RApacheInfo error
parts:

Other RApache handling seems to work, but the r-info handler is giving me this error (in apache's error log, along with a warning):

[Thu Dec 04 20:05:13 2014] [error] [client XXX.XXX.XXX.XXX] rApache Notice!

In addition: Warning message:                                                                                                                          
In is.na(st) : is.na() applied to non-(list or vector) of type 'closure'        

Version 1.2.6 of rApache, installed as part of a manual build/installation of OpenCPU (though the rApache issue with RApacheInfo manifested itself prior to OpenCPU installation).                                        

Anyone ever see this before?
